profile.headline: Tech at EATS2SEATS LLC
profile.summary: I do tech at Eats2Seats, where I lead our platform rebuild and manage the infrastructure behind our event staffing operations. Before that I was a computer vision and machine learning R&D engineer at Kitware, building models for satellite imagery and aerial tracking. I studied business at UNC Kenan-Flagler as a Cato Scholar. My interests are in full stack development with a focus on infrastructure, networking, AI/ML, and computer vision.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Chapel Hill, North Carolina, United States · On-site
positions.description: Sole engineer responsible for the availability and reliability of all production systems. Architected the new platform end-to-end: API, web portal, and React Native mobile app with offline-first sync. Migrated payroll operations to a new entity as part of a company acquisition, identified and resolved a longstanding compliance gap in payroll deductions, and negotiated vendor contracts that reduced per-unit costs 25-40%.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · NestJS · Node.js · React Native · React.js · PostgreSQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Amazon ECS · Docker · Terraform · Python (Programming Language) · System Architecture · Technical Leadership · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Research Development Software Engineer
positions.description: Built computer vision and machine learning models in PyTorch for government and defense applications. Developed super-resolution neural networks for satellite imagery, 3D tracking models for ballistic projectiles from aerial footage, and document categorization and data extraction models for scanned oil well log archives.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · PyTorch · Computer Vision · Neural Networks · Machine Learning · Deep Learning · Image Processing · Data Analytics
